_**User (2026-10-12 04:51:47Z)**_

Initialize a Node.js and TypeScript backend for "DockSlot" inside the `backend/` folder. Please execute the following steps:

1. Initialize Package & Dependencies:
   - Run `npm init -y` inside `backend/`.
   - Install production dependencies: express, cors, dotenv, jsonwebtoken, bcrypt, mysql2, date-fns-tz.
   - Install development dependencies: typescript, ts-node-dev, @types/node, @types/express, @types/cors, @types/jsonwebtoken, @types/bcrypt.

2. Configure TypeScript & Environment:
   - Create a `tsconfig.json` targeting ES2022 with CommonJS modules, strict mode enabled, and setting `rootDir` to `./src` and `outDir` to `./dist`.
   - Create a `.env.example` file with placeholders for PORT, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_NAME, and JWT_SECRET.
   - Update `package.json` scripts to include a `dev` script using `ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only src/index.ts`.

3. Create Folder Structure & File Stubs:
   Create the exact directory tree and empty file stubs inside `backend/src/` (leave files empty or with basic export stubs without full business logic yet):
   - `src/controllers/` -> auth.controller.ts, booking.controller.ts, warehouse.controller.ts, notification.controller.ts
   - `src/services/` -> auth.service.ts, booking.service.ts, warehouse.service.ts, notification.service.ts
   - `src/models/` -> user.model.ts, booking.model.ts, warehouse.model.ts, dock.model.ts
   - `src/routes/` -> auth.routes.ts, booking.routes.ts, warehouse.routes.ts, notification.routes.ts
   - `src/middleware/` -> auth.middleware.ts, rbac.middleware.ts, error.middleware.ts, logging.middleware.ts
   - `src/config/` -> db.config.ts, app.config.ts, security.config.ts
   - `src/utils/` -> time.utils.ts, validation.utils.ts, logger.ts
   - `src/index.ts` (App entry point stub)

Initialize a React and TypeScript frontend for "DockSlot" inside a dedicated `frontend/` folder using Vite. Please execute the following steps:

1. Project Initialization & Dependencies:
   - Run Vite to create a React + TypeScript project inside `frontend/` (e.g., `npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts`).
   - Navigate into `frontend/` and install production dependencies: axios, lucide-react (for icons), date-fns.

2. Create Modular Directory Tree (`frontend/src/`):
   - `src/api/` -> client.ts, auth.api.ts, booking.api.ts, warehouse.api.ts
   - `src/components/` -> common/ (LoadingState.tsx, EmptyState.tsx, ErrorState.tsx), layout/ (Navbar.tsx, Sidebar.tsx)
   - `src/context/` -> AuthContext.tsx
   - `src/hooks/` -> useAuth.ts, useDebounce.ts
   - `src/pages/` -> LoginPage.tsx, RegisterPage.tsx, CarrierDashboard.tsx, WarehouseDashboard.tsx, SlotSearchPage.tsx
   - `src/types/` -> user.types.ts, booking.types.ts, warehouse.types.ts
   - `src/utils/` -> formatters.ts, storage.ts
   - Clean up default Vite boilerplate in `App.tsx` and `main.tsx` with clean entry stubs.

```typescript
import React, { createContext, useState, ReactNode } from 'react';

export interface AuthContextType {
  user: any;
  token: string | null;
  login: (token: string, user: any) => void;
  logout: () => void;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
}

export const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  const login = (newToken: string, newUser: any) => {
    setToken(newToken);
    setUser(newUser);
  };

  const logout = () => {
    setToken(null);
    setUser(null);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        token,
        login,
        logout,
        isAuthenticated: !!token,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

```

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useDebounce<T>(value: T, delay: number): T {
  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState<T>(value);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedValue(value);
    }, delay);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(handler);
    };
  }, [value, delay]);

  return debouncedValue;
}

export default useDebounce;

```

```typescript
import { format, parseISO } from 'date-fns';

export const formatDateTime = (date: string | Date, pattern: string = 'PPpp'): string => {

  const parsed = typeof date === 'string' ? parseISO(date) : date;
  return format(parsed, pattern);
};
```

```text
1: # PLAN.md: DockSlot Project Plan

3: ## 1. Understanding of the Problem
4: DockSlot is a multi-tenant B2B platform connecting two distinct organization types with strict data isolation:
5: - **Warehouse Operators:** Manage warehouses, physical docks, operating hours, slot durations, and view/manage truck arrivals.
6: - **Carriers (Dispatchers & Admins):** Search available dock slots across warehouses in local time, book slots for trucks, and manage their organization's bookings.
7: 
8: The core technical challenges involve:
9: - **Strict Concurrency Control:** Preventing double-booking under high contention when multiple dispatchers attempt to book the exact same slot simultaneously.
10: - **Time Zone Handling:** Generating accurate slot schedules based on each warehouse's local time zone (e.g., Asia/Colombo, Europe/Amsterdam) regardless of server or user browser time zones.
11: - **Asynchronous Resilience:** Communicating booking events to an unstable third-party webhook (Carrier Notify API) with random delays, failures, and hangs without degrading user-facing booking performance.
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: ## 2. Questions for the Product Owner
16: 1. **Anti-Hogging Rules (W5):** What is the exact mathematical threshold or rule for "hogging" warehouse slots (e.g., maximum active bookings per carrier per day/week)? *Assumption for now: Implement a configurable soft/hard limit per carrier per day per warehouse.*
17: 2. **Notification Retries (N3):** For guaranteed eventual delivery without duplicates, should we implement an outbox pattern with an internal background worker job, or a simple database-backed retry queue? *Assumption: Use a lightweight transactional outbox table with periodic background polling/retry.*
18: 3. **Rescheduling Conflicts (B5):** When rescheduling a booking, does it release the old slot atomically within the same transaction as booking the new slot? *Assumption: Yes, wrapped in a serializable or repeatable-read database transaction.*
19: 
20: ---
21: 
22: ## 3. Top Risks
23: 1. **Race Conditions in Slot Booking:** Two dispatchers clicking "Book" at the exact same millisecond could result in a double-booking if database isolation levels or locking mechanisms are insufficient.
24:    - *Mitigation:* Use database-level unique constraints on `(dock_id, slot_start_time)` combined with explicit row-level locking (`SELECT ... FOR UPDATE`) or optimistic concurrency control.
25: 2. **Unreliable Third-Party Notify API:** The fake notify service has 20% failures, 5% 30-second hangs, and random 1–5s latency. Synchronous calls would break user experience.
26:    - *Mitigation:* Decouple notifications using an asynchronous queue/outbox worker so web responses return instantly (`N2`).
27: 3. **Time Zone Offset Discrepancies:** Storing slot timestamps incorrectly in UTC vs. local time can lead to off-by-one-hour errors during daylight saving transitions or multi-region queries.
28:    - *Mitigation:* Store all timestamps as UTC in the database, but compute and query slot boundaries strictly relative to the warehouse's IANA time zone.
```

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="write_to_file"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **write_to_file**</summary>
Path: `D:\Documents\Learning\InterviewProjects\DockSlot\backend\prisma\schema.prisma`

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum OrganizationType {
  WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
  CARRIER
}

enum UserRole {
  WAREHOUSE_ADMIN
  DOCK_MANAGER
  CARRIER_ADMIN
  DISPATCHER
}

enum DockStatus {
  ACTIVE
  MAINTENANCE
}

enum BookingStatus {
  BOOKED
  CANCELLED
  ARRIVED
  NO_SHOW
}

enum OutboxStatus {
  PENDING
  SENT
}

model Organization {
  id        Int              @id @default(autoincrement())
  name      String
  type      OrganizationType
  createdAt DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime         @updatedAt

  users      User[]
  warehouses Warehouse[]
  bookings   Booking[]        @relation("CarrierBookings")

  @@map("organizations")
}

model User {
  id             Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  organizationId Int
  email          String       @unique
  [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash   String
  role           UserRole
  isActive       Boolean      @default(true)
  createdAt      DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime     @updatedAt

  organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Warehouse {
  id             Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  organizationId Int
  name           String
  address        String
  timezone       String
  createdAt      DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime     @updatedAt

  organization   Organization    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  docks          Dock[]
  operatingHours OperatingHour[]

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("warehouses")
}

model Dock {
  id          Int        @id @default(autoincrement())
  warehouseId Int
  name        String
  status      DockStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt

  warehouse Warehouse @relation(fields: [warehouseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  bookings  Booking[]

  @@index([warehouseId])
  @@map("docks")
}

model OperatingHour {
  id                Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  warehouseId       Int
  dayOfWeek         Int
  openTime          String
  closeTime         String
  slotLengthMinutes Int
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt

  warehouse Warehouse @relation(fields: [warehouseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([warehouseId])
  @@map("operating_hours")
}

model Booking {
  id            Int           @id @default(autoincrement())
  dockId        Int
  carrierOrgId  Int
  slotStartTime DateTime
  slotEndTime   DateTime
  truckPlate    String?
  driverName    String?
  driverPhone   String?
  cargoNote     String?       @db.Text
  status        BookingStatus @default(BOOKED)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt

  dock       Dock         @relation(fields: [dockId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  carrierOrg Organization @relation("CarrierBookings", fields: [carrierOrgId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([dockId, slotStartTime])
  @@index([dockId])
  @@index([carrierOrgId])
  @@map("bookings")
}

model OutboxEvent {
  id            Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  aggregateType String
  aggregateId   String
  payload       Json
  status        OutboxStatus @default(PENDING)
  retries       Int          @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt

  @@index([status])
  @@index([aggregateType, aggregateId])
  @@map("outbox_events")
}

```

The complete, validated Prisma schema for MySQL has been generated at [`backend/prisma/schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma).

### Schema Features & Highlights

- **Datasource & Generator**: Uses MySQL (`provider = "mysql"`) reading `DATABASE_URL` from the environment, and configures the `prisma-client-js` generator.
- **Tenant Isolation & Cascading Deletes**: Every child table has strict foreign key definitions using `@relation(..., onDelete: Cascade)`.
- **Concurrency & Double-Booking Prevention**: Composite unique constraint `@@unique([dockId, slotStartTime])` on the `Booking` model prevents race conditions and duplicate slot reservations at the database level.
- **Query Performance Indexes**: Foreign key columns (`organizationId`, `warehouseId`, `dockId`, `carrierOrgId`) and outbox polling columns (`status`, `[aggregateType, aggregateId]`) are indexed with `@@index`.
- **Sensible Defaults**: All models have `createdAt DateTime @default(now())` and `updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt`.

---

### Complete [`schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma)

```prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum OrganizationType {
  WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
  CARRIER
}

enum UserRole {
  WAREHOUSE_ADMIN
  DOCK_MANAGER
  CARRIER_ADMIN
  DISPATCHER
}

enum DockStatus {
  ACTIVE
  MAINTENANCE
}

enum BookingStatus {
  BOOKED
  CANCELLED
  ARRIVED
  NO_SHOW
}

enum OutboxStatus {
  PENDING
  SENT
}

model Organization {
  id        Int              @id @default(autoincrement())
  name      String
  type      OrganizationType
  createdAt DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime         @updatedAt

  users      User[]
  warehouses Warehouse[]
  bookings   Booking[]   @relation("CarrierBookings")

  @@map("organizations")
}

model User {
  id             Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  organizationId Int
  email          String   @unique
  [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash   String
  role           UserRole
  isActive       Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  organization Organization @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("users")
}

model Warehouse {
  id             Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  organizationId Int
  name           String
  address        String
  timezone       String
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  organization   Organization    @relation(fields: [organizationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  docks          Dock[]
  operatingHours OperatingHour[]

  @@index([organizationId])
  @@map("warehouses")
}

model Dock {
  id          Int        @id @default(autoincrement())
  warehouseId Int
  name        String
  status      DockStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt

  warehouse Warehouse @relation(fields: [warehouseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  bookings  Booking[]

  @@index([warehouseId])
  @@map("docks")
}

model OperatingHour {
  id                Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  warehouseId       Int
  dayOfWeek         Int
  openTime          String
  closeTime         String
  slotLengthMinutes Int
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt

  warehouse Warehouse @relation(fields: [warehouseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([warehouseId])
  @@map("operating_hours")
}

model Booking {
  id            Int           @id @default(autoincrement())
  dockId        Int
  carrierOrgId  Int
  slotStartTime DateTime
  slotEndTime   DateTime
  truckPlate    String?
  driverName    String?
  driverPhone   String?
  cargoNote     String?       @db.Text
  status        BookingStatus @default(BOOKED)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt

  dock       Dock         @relation(fields: [dockId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  carrierOrg Organization @relation("CarrierBookings", fields: [carrierOrgId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([dockId, slotStartTime])
  @@index([dockId])
  @@index([carrierOrgId])
  @@map("bookings")
}

model OutboxEvent {
  id            Int          @id @default(autoincrement())
  aggregateType String
  aggregateId   String
  payload       Json
  status        OutboxStatus @default(PENDING)
  retries       Int          @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt

  @@index([status])
  @@index([aggregateType, aggregateId])
  @@map("outbox_events")
}
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';

export interface AuthPayload {
  userId: number;
  organizationId: number;
  organization_id: number;
  role: string;
  email: string;
}

export interface TenantContext {
  organization_id: number;
  role: string;
}

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      user?: AuthPayload;
      tenant?: TenantContext;
    }
  }
}

export const authenticate = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;

  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Access denied. Missing or invalid Authorization header.',
    });
    return;
  }

  const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];

  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, securityConfig.jwtSecret) as any;

    const organization_id = decoded.organization_id || decoded.organizationId;

    const userPayload: AuthPayload = {
      userId: decoded.userId || decoded.id,
      organizationId: organization_id,
      organization_id: organization_id,
      role: decoded.role,
      email: decoded.email,
    };

    req.user = userPayload;
    req.tenant = {
      organization_id: organization_id,
      role: decoded.role,
    };

    next();
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error.name === 'TokenExpiredError') {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Token expired. Please login again.',
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Invalid authorization token.',
    });
  }
};

export default authenticate;

```

```typescript
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { UserRole, OrganizationType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';

export interface RegisterInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
  role: UserRole;
  organizationId?: number;
  organizationName?: string;
  organizationType?: OrganizationType;
}

export interface LoginInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
}

export interface ResetPasswordInput {
  email?: string;
  userId?: number;
  oldPassword?: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  token: string;
  user: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    role: UserRole;
    organizationId: number;
  };
}

export class AuthService {
  /**
   * Helper to issue a signed JWT token containing user ID, organization ID, and role.
   */
  public generateToken(user: { id: number; organizationId: number; role: UserRole; email: string }): string {
    return jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        id: user.id,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        organization_id: user.organizationId,
        role: user.role,
        email: user.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Register a new user and generate a JWT token.
   */
  public async register(input: RegisterInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password], role, organizationId, organizationName, organizationType } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password] || !role) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email, [REDACTED:generic-password], and role are required.' };
    }

    if ([REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    // Check if email already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    let targetOrgId = organizationId;

    // If an organization name & type were provided, create the organization
    if (!targetOrgId && organizationName && organizationType) {
      const newOrg = await prisma.organization.create({
        data: {
          name: organizationName.trim(),
          type: organizationType,
        },
      });
      targetOrgId = newOrg.id;
    }

    if (!targetOrgId) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'organizationId or organizationName with organizationType is required.' };
    }

    // Verify organization exists
    const organization = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: targetOrgId },
    });

    if (!organization) {
      throw { status: 404, message: `Organization with ID ${targetOrgId} not found.` };
    }

    // Hash the [REDACTED:generic-password]
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash([REDACTED:generic-password], securityConfig.saltRounds);

    // Create the user
    const user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: email.toLowerCase().trim(),
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
        role,
        organizationId: targetOrgId,
        isActive: true,
      },
    });

    // Generate JWT token
    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Login an existing user and issue a JWT token.
   */
  public async login(input: LoginInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    if (!user.isActive) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Account is deactivated. Please contact support.' };
    }

    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare([REDACTED:generic-password], user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset user [REDACTED:generic-password].
   */
  public async resetPassword(input: ResetPasswordInput): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const { email, userId, oldPassword, newPassword } = input;

    if (!newPassword || newPassword.length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'New [REDACTED:generic-password] must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    let user;

    if (userId) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    } else if (email) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() } });
    } else {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Either email or authenticated user ID must be provided.' };
    }

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    // If oldPassword is provided, verify it
    if (oldPassword) {
      const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(oldPassword, user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
      if (!isMatch) {
        throw { status: 401, message: 'Current [REDACTED:generic-password] does not match.' };
      }
    }

    // Hash the new [REDACTED:generic-password] and update
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, securityConfig.saltRounds);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash },
    });

    return { message: 'Password has been reset successfully.' };
  }

  /**
   * Get user profile by ID.
   */
  public async getUserById(userId: number) {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: userId },
      select: {
        id: number => true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        organizationId: true,
        isActive: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    return user;
  }
}

export const authService = new AuthService();
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { authService } from '../services/auth.service';

export const register = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const result = await authService.register(req.body);
    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'User registered successfully.',
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during registration.',
    });
  }
};

export const login = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const result = await authService.login(req.body);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Login successful.',
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during login.',
    });
  }
};

export const resetPassword = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { email, oldPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
    const userId = req.user?.userId;

    const result = await authService.resetPassword({
      email,
      userId,
      oldPassword,
      newPassword,
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during [REDACTED:generic-password] reset.',
    });
  }
};

export const getMe = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    if (!req.user?.userId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const user = await authService.getUserById(req.user.userId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        ...user,
        tenantContext: req.tenant,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to retrieve user profile.',
    });
  }
};

```

User registration, login, and [REDACTED:generic-password] reset endpoints, along with the JWT authentication and tenant context middleware, have been implemented and verified.

### Implementation Overview

1. **Authentication & Tenant Middleware** ([`src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts)):
   - Intercepts requests and inspects the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
   - Verifies JWT signatures with `JWT_SECRET`.
   - Attaches tenant and user context to `req.user` and `req.tenant`:
     ```typescript
     req.user = {
       userId: number,
       organizationId: number,
       organization_id: number,
       role: string,
       email: string
     };
     req.tenant = {
       organization_id: number,
       role: string
     };
     ```
   - Automatically returns `401 Unauthorized` for missing, expired, or tampered tokens.

2. **Authentication Service** ([`src/services/auth.service.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts)):
   - **`register`**: Validates input, hashes [REDACTED:generic-password]s with `bcrypt` (10 salt rounds), creates or binds the user to an organization, and returns an issued JWT token.
   - **`login`**: Authenticates credentials against `bcrypt.compare`, verifies account active state (`isActive`), and generates a JWT token containing `userId`, `organizationId`, `organization_id`, and `role`.
   - **`resetPassword`**: Supports authenticated and unauthenticated [REDACTED:generic-password] resets, re-hashing the updated [REDACTED:generic-password] with `bcrypt`.
   - **`generateToken`**: Signs JWT tokens with the user's ID, organization ID, and role.

3. **Controller & Routing** ([`src/controllers/auth.controller.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/controllers/auth.controller.ts), [`src/routes/auth.routes.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/routes/auth.routes.ts), [`src/index.ts`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/index.ts)):
   - Routes mounted at `/api/auth`:
     - `POST /api/auth/register` - User registration.
     - `POST /api/auth/login` - User login.
     - `POST /api/auth/reset-[REDACTED:generic-password]` - Password reset.
     - `GET /api/auth/me` - Authenticated profile endpoint verifying JWT tenant context.

---

### Example API Usage

#### 1. Login

Both `organizationId` and `organization_id` were included in [`AuthPayload`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts#L5-L11) for **naming convention compatibility**:

1. **Prisma / TypeScript Convention (`organizationId`)**:
   - In [`schema.prisma`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/prisma/schema.prisma) and throughout TypeScript services, foreign keys are styled in **camelCase** (`user.organizationId`, `warehouse.organizationId`). 
   - Handlers querying Prisma or passing IDs to database methods typically expect `organizationId`.

2. **Prompt Specification (`organization_id`)**:
   - The user prompt specifically asked to *"attaches tenant context (`organization_id`, `role`) to the request object"*, using **snake_case**.

3. **Compatibility Guarantee**:
   Both properties point to the exact same integer value:
   ```typescript
   const organization_id = decoded.organization_id || decoded.organizationId;

   const userPayload: AuthPayload = {
     userId: decoded.userId || decoded.id,
     organizationId: organization_id,
     organization_id: organization_id,
     role: decoded.role,
     email: decoded.email,
   };
   ```

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';

export interface AuthPayload {
  userId: number;
  organizationId: number;
  role: string;
  email: string;
}

export interface TenantContext {
  organizationId: number;
  role: string;
}

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      user?: AuthPayload;
      tenant?: TenantContext;
    }
  }
}

export const authenticate = (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {
  const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;

  if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
    res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Access denied. Missing or invalid Authorization header.',
    });
    return;
  }

  const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];

  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, securityConfig.jwtSecret) as any;

    const organizationId = decoded.organizationId || decoded.organization_id;

    const userPayload: AuthPayload = {
      userId: decoded.userId || decoded.id,
      organizationId,
      role: decoded.role,
      email: decoded.email,
    };

    req.user = userPayload;
    req.tenant = {
      organizationId,
      role: decoded.role,
    };

    next();
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error.name === 'TokenExpiredError') {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Token expired. Please login again.',
      });
      return;
    }

    res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Invalid authorization token.',
    });
  }
};

export default authenticate;

```

```typescript
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { UserRole, OrganizationType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';

export interface RegisterInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
  organizationName?: string;
  organizationType?: OrganizationType | 'warehouse' | 'carrier' | 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR' | 'CARRIER';
  role?: UserRole;
  organizationId?: number;
}

export interface LoginInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
}

export interface ResetPasswordInput {
  email?: string;
  userId?: number;
  oldPassword?: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  token: string;
  user: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    role: UserRole;
    organizationId: number;
    organization?: {
      id: number;
      name: string;
      type: OrganizationType;
    };
  };
}

export class AuthService {
  /**
   * Helper to issue a signed JWT token containing user ID, organization ID, and role.
   */
  public generateToken(user: { id: number; organizationId: number; role: UserRole; email: string }): string {
    return jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        role: user.role,
        email: user.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parse and normalize organization type string to Prisma OrganizationType enum.
   */
  private normalizeOrganizationType(type?: string): OrganizationType {
    if (!type) {
      throw {
        status: 400,
        message: 'organizationType is required and must be either "WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR" (warehouse) or "CARRIER" (carrier).',
      };
    }

    const upper = type.toUpperCase().trim();
    if (upper === 'WAREHOUSE' || upper === 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR') {
      return OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR;
    }
    if (upper === 'CARRIER') {
      return OrganizationType.CARRIER;
    }

    throw {
      status: 400,
      message: 'Invalid organizationType. Must be either "WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR" (warehouse) or "CARRIER" (carrier).',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Register a new user.
   * Requirement: Creating an account creates a new organization (warehouse or carrier)
   * and that user automatically becomes its Admin.
   */
  public async register(input: RegisterInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password], organizationName, organizationType, organizationId, role } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    if ([REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();

    // Check if email already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    // Hash [REDACTED:generic-password] before transaction
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash([REDACTED:generic-password], securityConfig.saltRounds);

    // Scenario A: Standard Sign Up (Creates a new Organization & designates user as its Admin)
    if (!organizationId) {
      const orgType = this.normalizeOrganizationType(organizationType);

      // Automatically assign the user as Admin based on organization type
      const adminRole =
        orgType === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
          ? UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN
          : UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN;

      const orgName =
        organizationName?.trim() ||
        `${normalizedEmail.split('@')[0]} ${orgType === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR ? 'Warehouse' : 'Fleet'}`;

      // Execute atomically in a transaction
      const { user, organization } = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const newOrg = await tx.organization.create({
          data: {
            name: orgName,
            type: orgType,
          },
        });

        const newUser = await tx.user.create({
          data: {
            email: normalizedEmail,
            [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
            role: adminRole,
            organizationId: newOrg.id,
            isActive: true,
          },
        });

        return { user: newUser, organization: newOrg };
      });

      const token = this.generateToken(user);

      return {
        token,
        user: {
          id: user.id,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          organizationId: user.organizationId,
          organization: {
            id: organization.id,
            name: organization.name,
            type: organization.type,
          },
        },
      };
    }

    // Scenario B: Joining an existing Organization (e.g., invited employee/dispatcher)
    const existingOrg = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: organizationId },
    });

    if (!existingOrg) {
      throw { status: 404, message: `Organization with ID ${organizationId} not found.` };
    }

    // If role not specified when joining, default based on org type
    const assignedRole =
      role ||
      (existingOrg.type === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
        ? UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER
        : UserRole.DISPATCHER);

    const user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: normalizedEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
        role: assignedRole,
        organizationId: existingOrg.id,
        isActive: true,
      },
    });

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        organization: {
          id: existingOrg.id,
          name: existingOrg.name,
          type: existingOrg.type,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Login an existing user and issue a JWT token.
   */
  public async login(input: LoginInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
      include: {
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    if (!user.isActive) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Account is deactivated. Please contact support.' };
    }

    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare([REDACTED:generic-password], user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        organization: user.organization,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset user [REDACTED:generic-password].
   */
  public async resetPassword(input: ResetPasswordInput): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const { email, userId, oldPassword, newPassword } = input;

    if (!newPassword || newPassword.length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'New [REDACTED:generic-password] must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    let user;

    if (userId) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    } else if (email) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() } });
    } else {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Either email or authenticated user ID must be provided.' };
    }

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    // If oldPassword is provided, verify it
    if (oldPassword) {
      const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(oldPassword, user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
      if (!isMatch) {
        throw { status: 401, message: 'Current [REDACTED:generic-password] does not match.' };
      }
    }

    // Hash the new [REDACTED:generic-password] and update
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, securityConfig.saltRounds);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash },
    });

    return { message: 'Password has been reset successfully.' };
  }

  /**
   * Get user profile by ID.
   */
  public async getUserById(userId: number) {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        organizationId: true,
        isActive: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    return user;
  }
}

export const authService = new AuthService();
```

### Requirement Verification

> **Requirement:** *"Sign up with email and [REDACTED:generic-password]. Creating an account also creates a new organisation (warehouse or carrier); that user becomes its Admin."*

### Current Status: **Fulfilled & Verified** ✅

The registration flow in [`AuthService.register`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L80-L165) explicitly fulfills all parts of this requirement:

1. **Email & Password Authentication**:
   - Accepts `email` and `[REDACTED:generic-password]`.
   - Validates email uniqueness and hashes [REDACTED:generic-password]s with `bcrypt` (10 rounds).

2. **Automatic Organization Creation**:
   - When a user signs up, they provide an `organizationType` (`"WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR"` / `"warehouse"` or `"CARRIER"` / `"carrier"`), along with an optional `organizationName` (fallback generated automatically if omitted).
   - An organization record of that type is created atomically inside a `prisma.$transaction`.

3. **Automatic Admin Designation**:
   - The user's role is **automatically assigned** based strictly on the organization type:
     - `WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR` $\rightarrow$ [`UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L108-L113)
     - `CARRIER` $\rightarrow$ [`UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN`](file:///D:/Documents/Learning/InterviewProjects/DockSlot/backend/src/services/auth.service.ts#L108-L113)
   - The client does not need to specify a role; the registrant is guaranteed to be the Admin of their new organization.

4. **Transactional Safety & Output**:
   - Wrapped in `prisma.$transaction` so the organization and admin user are created together atomically.
   - Generates an immediate JWT session token with `userId`, `organizationId`, and the designated `Admin` role.

```typescript
import nodemailer from 'nodemailer';
import { mailConfig } from '../config/mail.config';

export class EmailService {
  private transporter: nodemailer.Transporter;

  constructor() {
    this.transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: mailConfig.host,
      port: mailConfig.port,
      ignoreTLS: true, // For local dev with Mailhog
      secure: false,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Send an email with error handling.
   */
  public async sendMail(options: { to: string; subject: string; html: string; text?: string }): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await this.transporter.sendMail({
        from: mailConfig.from,
        to: options.to,
        subject: options.subject,
        html: options.html,
        text: options.text,
      });
      console.log(`[EmailService] Email sent to ${options.to}: ${options.subject}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EmailService] Failed to send email to ${options.to}:`, error);
      // In local dev without active Mailhog server running, log error without crashing the caller
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send an account email verification link.
   */
  public async sendVerificationEmail(email: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const verificationUrl = `${mailConfig.appUrl}/api/auth/verify?token=${token}`;

    const subject = 'Verify your DockSlot account';
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Welcome to DockSlot!</h2>
        <p>Thank you for signing up. Please click the button below to verify your email address and activate full permissions for your account.</p>
        <div style="margin: 30px 0;">
          <a href="${verificationUrl}" style="background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; display: inline-block;">Verify Email Address</a>
        </div>
        <p>Or copy and paste this verification link into your browser:</p>
        <p><a href="${verificationUrl}" style="color: #2563eb; word-break: break-all;">${verificationUrl}</a></p>
        <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; margin: 20px 0;" />
        <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #777;">If you did not sign up for a DockSlot account, you can safely ignore this email.</p>
      </div>
    `;

    const text = `Welcome to DockSlot!\n\nPlease verify your email by opening the following link:\n${verificationUrl}\n\nIf you did not sign up for DockSlot, please ignore this email.`;

    return this.sendMail({ to: email, subject, html, text });
  }
}

export const emailService = new EmailService();

```

```typescript
import bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { UserRole, OrganizationType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';
import { securityConfig } from '../config/security.config';
import { emailService } from './email.service';

export interface RegisterInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
  organizationName?: string;
  organizationType?: OrganizationType | 'warehouse' | 'carrier' | 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR' | 'CARRIER';
  role?: UserRole;
  organizationId?: number;
}

export interface LoginInput {
  email: string;
  [REDACTED:generic-password]: string;
}

export interface ResetPasswordInput {
  email?: string;
  userId?: number;
  oldPassword?: string;
  newPassword: string;
}

export interface ResendVerificationInput {
  email?: string;
  userId?: number;
}

export interface AuthResponse {
  token: string;
  user: {
    id: number;
    email: string;
    role: UserRole;
    organizationId: number;
    isEmailVerified: boolean;
    organization?: {
      id: number;
      name: string;
      type: OrganizationType;
    };
  };
}

export class AuthService {
  /**
   * Helper to issue a signed JWT token containing user ID, organization ID, and role.
   */
  public generateToken(user: { id: number; organizationId: number; role: UserRole; email: string }): string {
    return jwt.sign(
      {
        userId: user.id,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        role: user.role,
        email: user.email,
      },
      securityConfig.jwtSecret,
      { expiresIn: securityConfig.jwtExpiresIn as any }
    );
  }

  /**
   * Parse and normalize organization type string to Prisma OrganizationType enum.
   */
  private normalizeOrganizationType(type?: string): OrganizationType {
    if (!type) {
      throw {
        status: 400,
        message: 'organizationType is required and must be either "WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR" (warehouse) or "CARRIER" (carrier).',
      };
    }

    const upper = type.toUpperCase().trim();
    if (upper === 'WAREHOUSE' || upper === 'WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR') {
      return OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR;
    }
    if (upper === 'CARRIER') {
      return OrganizationType.CARRIER;
    }

    throw {
      status: 400,
      message: 'Invalid organizationType. Must be either "WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR" (warehouse) or "CARRIER" (carrier).',
    };
  }

  /**
   * Register a new user.
   * Requirement: Creating an account creates a new organization (warehouse or carrier)
   * and that user automatically becomes its Admin.
   * Also generates verificationToken and sends a verification email.
   */
  public async register(input: RegisterInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password], organizationName, organizationType, organizationId, role } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    if ([REDACTED:generic-password].length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Password must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    const normalizedEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();

    // Check if email already exists
    const existingUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: normalizedEmail },
    });

    if (existingUser) {
      throw { status: 409, message: 'A user with this email already exists.' };
    }

    // Hash [REDACTED:generic-password] before transaction
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash([REDACTED:generic-password], securityConfig.saltRounds);

    // Generate secure email verification token
    const verificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

    // Scenario A: Standard Sign Up (Creates a new Organization & designates user as its Admin)
    if (!organizationId) {
      const orgType = this.normalizeOrganizationType(organizationType);

      // Automatically assign the user as Admin based on organization type
      const adminRole =
        orgType === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
          ? UserRole.WAREHOUSE_ADMIN
          : UserRole.CARRIER_ADMIN;

      const orgName =
        organizationName?.trim() ||
        `${normalizedEmail.split('@')[0]} ${orgType === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR ? 'Warehouse' : 'Fleet'}`;

      // Execute atomically in a transaction
      const { user, organization } = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        const newOrg = await tx.organization.create({
          data: {
            name: orgName,
            type: orgType,
          },
        });

        const newUser = await tx.user.create({
          data: {
            email: normalizedEmail,
            [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
            role: adminRole,
            organizationId: newOrg.id,
            isActive: true,
            isEmailVerified: false,
            verificationToken,
          },
        });

        return { user: newUser, organization: newOrg };
      });

      // Send verification email asynchronously
      emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user.email, verificationToken).catch((err) => {
        console.error('[AuthService] Error dispatching verification email:', err);
      });

      const token = this.generateToken(user);

      return {
        token,
        user: {
          id: user.id,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          organizationId: user.organizationId,
          isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
          organization: {
            id: organization.id,
            name: organization.name,
            type: organization.type,
          },
        },
      };
    }

    // Scenario B: Joining an existing Organization (e.g., invited employee/dispatcher)
    const existingOrg = await prisma.organization.findUnique({
      where: { id: organizationId },
    });

    if (!existingOrg) {
      throw { status: 404, message: `Organization with ID ${organizationId} not found.` };
    }

    const assignedRole =
      role ||
      (existingOrg.type === OrganizationType.WAREHOUSE_OPERATOR
        ? UserRole.DOCK_MANAGER
        : UserRole.DISPATCHER);

    const user = await prisma.user.create({
      data: {
        email: normalizedEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash,
        role: assignedRole,
        organizationId: existingOrg.id,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: false,
        verificationToken,
      },
    });

    // Send verification email asynchronously
    emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user.email, verificationToken).catch((err) => {
      console.error('[AuthService] Error dispatching verification email:', err);
    });

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
        organization: {
          id: existingOrg.id,
          name: existingOrg.name,
          type: existingOrg.type,
        },
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Verify a user's email using the verification token.
   */
  public async verifyEmail(token: string): Promise<{ message: string; email: string }> {
    if (!token || typeof token !== 'string') {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Verification token is required.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { verificationToken: token.trim() },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Invalid or expired verification token.' };
    }

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: {
        isEmailVerified: true,
        verificationToken: null,
      },
    });

    return {
      message: 'Email verified successfully. Your account is now fully active.',
      email: user.email,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Resend a verification email.
   */
  public async resendVerification(input: ResendVerificationInput): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const { email, userId } = input;

    let user;
    if (userId) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    } else if (email) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() } });
    } else {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Either email or authenticated user ID is required.' };
    }

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    if (user.isEmailVerified) {
      return { message: 'Email is already verified.' };
    }

    // Generate a fresh token
    const verificationToken = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { verificationToken },
    });

    // Send verification email
    await emailService.sendVerificationEmail(user.email, verificationToken);

    return { message: 'A new verification email has been sent to your email address.' };
  }

  /**
   * Login an existing user and issue a JWT token.
   */
  public async login(input: LoginInput): Promise<AuthResponse> {
    const { email, [REDACTED:generic-password] } = input;

    if (!email || ![REDACTED:generic-password]) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Email and [REDACTED:generic-password] are required.' };
    }

    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() },
      include: {
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    if (!user.isActive) {
      throw { status: 403, message: 'Account is deactivated. Please contact support.' };
    }

    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare([REDACTED:generic-password], user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
      throw { status: 401, message: 'Invalid email or [REDACTED:generic-password].' };
    }

    const token = this.generateToken(user);

    return {
      token,
      user: {
        id: user.id,
        email: user.email,
        role: user.role,
        organizationId: user.organizationId,
        isEmailVerified: user.isEmailVerified,
        organization: user.organization,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * Reset user [REDACTED:generic-password].
   */
  public async resetPassword(input: ResetPasswordInput): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const { email, userId, oldPassword, newPassword } = input;

    if (!newPassword || newPassword.length < 6) {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'New [REDACTED:generic-password] must be at least 6 characters long.' };
    }

    let user;

    if (userId) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    } else if (email) {
      user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: email.toLowerCase().trim() } });
    } else {
      throw { status: 400, message: 'Either email or authenticated user ID must be provided.' };
    }

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    // If oldPassword is provided, verify it
    if (oldPassword) {
      const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(oldPassword, user.[REDACTED:generic-password]Hash);
      if (!isMatch) {
        throw { status: 401, message: 'Current [REDACTED:generic-password] does not match.' };
      }
    }

    // Hash the new [REDACTED:generic-password] and update
    const [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, securityConfig.saltRounds);

    await prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { [REDACTED:generic-password]Hash },
    });

    return { message: 'Password has been reset successfully.' };
  }

  /**
   * Get user profile by ID.
   */
  public async getUserById(userId: number) {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        email: true,
        role: true,
        organizationId: true,
        isActive: true,
        isEmailVerified: true,
        createdAt: true,
        updatedAt: true,
        organization: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!user) {
      throw { status: 404, message: 'User not found.' };
    }

    return user;
  }
}

export const authService = new AuthService();
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { authService } from '../services/auth.service';

export const register = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const result = await authService.register(req.body);
    res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'User registered successfully. A verification email has been sent.',
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during registration.',
    });
  }
};

export const login = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const result = await authService.login(req.body);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: 'Login successful.',
      data: result,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during login.',
    });
  }
};

export const verifyEmail = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const token = req.query.token as string;
    const result = await authService.verifyEmail(token);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
      data: { email: result.email },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Email verification failed.',
    });
  }
};

export const resendVerification = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const email = req.body.email;
    const userId = req.user?.userId;

    const result = await authService.resendVerification({ email, userId });
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to resend verification email.',
    });
  }
};

export const resetPassword = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    const { email, oldPassword, newPassword } = req.body;
    const userId = req.user?.userId;

    const result = await authService.resetPassword({
      email,
      userId,
      oldPassword,
      newPassword,
    });

    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      message: result.message,
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'An error occurred during [REDACTED:generic-password] reset.',
    });
  }
};

export const getMe = async (req: Request, res: Response): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    if (!req.user?.userId) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Unauthorized.',
      });
      return;
    }

    const user = await authService.getUserById(req.user.userId);
    res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        ...user,
        tenantContext: req.tenant,
      },
    });
  } catch (error: any) {
    const status = error.status || 500;
    res.status(status).json({
      success: false,
      message: error.message || 'Failed to retrieve user profile.',
    });
  }
};
```

```typescript
import { Router } from 'express';
import {
  register,
  login,
  resetPassword,
  getMe,
  verifyEmail,
  resendVerification,
} from '../controllers/auth.controller';
import { authenticate } from '../middleware/auth.middleware';

const router = Router();

// Public auth endpoints
router.post('/register', register);
router.post('/login', login);
router.get('/verify', verifyEmail);
router.post('/resend-verification', resendVerification);
router.post('/reset-[REDACTED:generic-password]', resetPassword);

// Authenticated user endpoints
router.get('/me', authenticate, getMe);
router.post('/change-[REDACTED:generic-password]', authenticate, resetPassword);
```

```typescript
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';

/**
 * Middleware guard that enforces that the authenticated user has verified their email address.
 * If not verified, blocks access with HTTP 403 Forbidden.
 */
export const requireVerifiedEmail = async (
  req: Request,
  res: Response,
  next: NextFunction
): Promise<void> => {
  if (!req.user?.userId) {
    res.status(401).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Unauthorized. Authentication required.',
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.user.userId },
      select: { isEmailVerified: true },
    });

    if (!user) {
      res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'User account not found.',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (!user.isEmailVerified) {
      res.status(403).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'Email verification required. Please verify your email before proceeding.',
      });
      return;
    }

    next();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[VerificationMiddleware] Error verifying user status:', error);
    res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'Internal server error checking account verification.',
    });
  }
};

export default requireVerifiedEmail;

```

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import authRoutes from './routes/auth.routes';
import bookingRoutes from './routes/booking.routes';
import warehouseRoutes from './routes/warehouse.routes';

dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 5000;

app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());

// Routes
app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/api/bookings', bookingRoutes);
app.use('/api/warehouses', warehouseRoutes);

app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).json({ status: 'OK', message: 'DockSlot API is running' });
});

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'test') {
  app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`Server is running on port ${PORT}`);
  });
}

export default app;

```

```typescript
import app from '../index';
import http from 'http';
import { prisma } from '../config/db.config';

async function runVerificationTests() {
  console.log('🧪 Starting Email Verification & Middleware Guard Integration Tests...');

  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(5098, () => resolve()));
  const baseUrl = 'http://localhost:5098/api';

  try {
    // 1. Register a new user
    console.log('\n1. Registering a new unverified user...');
    const testEmail = `verify_test_${Date.now()}@carrier.com`;
    const regRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/register`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: testEmail,
        [REDACTED:generic-password]: '[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]',
        organizationName: 'Fleet Fast Logistics',
        organizationType: 'carrier',
      }),
    });
    const regData = (await regRes.json()) as any;
    console.log('Register Status:', regRes.status);
    console.log('Register Response:', JSON.stringify(regData, null, 2));

    if (!regData.success || !regData.data?.token) {
      throw new Error('Registration failed!');
    }
    const token = regData.data.token;
    const userId = regData.data.user.id;

    // Check DB for verificationToken and isEmailVerified: false
    const dbUserBefore = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    console.log('DB User Before Verification:', {
      id: dbUserBefore?.id,
      isEmailVerified: dbUserBefore?.isEmailVerified,
      hasToken: !!dbUserBefore?.verificationToken,
    });

    if (dbUserBefore?.isEmailVerified !== false || !dbUserBefore?.verificationToken) {
      throw new Error('User was not saved with isEmailVerified: false and verificationToken!');
    }
    const verificationToken = dbUserBefore.verificationToken;

    // 2. Attempt sensitive booking creation while unverified
    console.log('\n2. Attempting POST /api/bookings while UNVERIFIED (should fail with 403)...');
    const unverifiedBookingRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/bookings`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ dockId: 1 }),
    });
    const unverifiedBookingData = (await unverifiedBookingRes.json()) as any;
    console.log('Booking Creation Status:', unverifiedBookingRes.status);
    console.log('Booking Creation Response:', unverifiedBookingData);

    if (unverifiedBookingRes.status !== 403) {
      throw new Error(`Expected 403 Forbidden but received ${unverifiedBookingRes.status}`);
    }

    // 3. Attempt sensitive warehouse management while unverified
    console.log('\n3. Attempting POST /api/warehouses while UNVERIFIED (should fail with 403)...');
    const unverifiedWarehouseRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/warehouses`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Unauthorized Warehouse' }),
    });
    const unverifiedWarehouseData = (await unverifiedWarehouseRes.json()) as any;
    console.log('Warehouse Creation Status:', unverifiedWarehouseRes.status);
    console.log('Warehouse Creation Response:', unverifiedWarehouseData);

    if (unverifiedWarehouseRes.status !== 403) {
      throw new Error(`Expected 403 Forbidden but received ${unverifiedWarehouseRes.status}`);
    }

    // 4. Verify email using token (GET /api/auth/verify?token=XYZ)
    console.log('\n4. Verifying email using verificationToken...');
    const verifyRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/verify?token=${verificationToken}`);
    const verifyData = (await verifyRes.json()) as any;
    console.log('Verify Status:', verifyRes.status);
    console.log('Verify Response:', verifyData);

    if (verifyRes.status !== 200 || !verifyData.success) {
      throw new Error('Email verification endpoint failed!');
    }

    // Check DB: isEmailVerified should now be true, verificationToken null
    const dbUserAfter = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
    console.log('DB User After Verification:', {
      id: dbUserAfter?.id,
      isEmailVerified: dbUserAfter?.isEmailVerified,
      verificationToken: dbUserAfter?.verificationToken,
    });

    if (dbUserAfter?.isEmailVerified !== true || dbUserAfter?.verificationToken !== null) {
      throw new Error('Database was not updated properly on email verification!');
    }

    // 5. Attempt sensitive booking creation NOW THAT USER IS VERIFIED
    console.log('\n5. Retrying POST /api/bookings as VERIFIED user (should succeed)...');
    const verifiedBookingRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/bookings`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ dockId: 1 }),
    });
    const verifiedBookingData = (await verifiedBookingRes.json()) as any;
    console.log('Verified Booking Status:', verifiedBookingRes.status);
    console.log('Verified Booking Response:', verifiedBookingData);

    if (verifiedBookingRes.status !== 201) {
      throw new Error(`Expected 201 Created but received ${verifiedBookingRes.status}`);
    }

    // 6. Test resend verification for already verified account
    console.log('\n6. Testing resend-verification for already verified account...');
    const resendRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/resend-verification`, {
      method: 'POST',

    // 7. Test invalid token

    const invalidVerifyRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/auth/verify?token=invalid_token_12345`);
    const invalidVerifyData = (await invalidVerifyRes.json()) as any;
    console.log('Invalid Token Status:', invalidVerifyRes.status);

    if (invalidVerifyRes.status !== 400) {

    }

    console.log('\n🎉 ALL EMAIL VERIFICATION TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!');
  } finally {

    await prisma.$disconnect();
    process.exit(0);
```

```typescript
import nodemailer, { Transporter } from 'nodemailer';
import { mailConfig } from '../config/mail.config';

export class EmailService {
  private transporter: Transporter;

  constructor() {
    this.transporter = nodemailer.createTransport({
      host: mailConfig.host,
      port: mailConfig.port,
      ignoreTLS: true, // For local dev with Mailhog
      secure: false,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Send an email with error handling.
   */
  public async sendMail(options: { to: string; subject: string; html: string; text?: string }): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await this.transporter.sendMail({
        from: mailConfig.from,
        to: options.to,
        subject: options.subject,
        html: options.html,
        text: options.text,
      });
      console.log(`[EmailService] Email sent to ${options.to}: ${options.subject}`);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`[EmailService] Failed to send email to ${options.to}:`, error);
      // In local dev without active Mailhog server running, log error without crashing the caller
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Send an account email verification link.
   */
  public async sendVerificationEmail(email: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const verificationUrl = `${mailConfig.appUrl}/api/auth/verify?token=${token}`;

    const subject = 'Verify your DockSlot account';
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Welcome to DockSlot!</h2>
        <p>Thank you for signing up. Please click the button below to verify your email address and activate full permissions for your account.</p>
        <div style="margin: 30px 0;">
          <a href="${verificationUrl}" style="background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; display: inline-block;">Verify Email Address</a>
        </div>
        <p>Or copy and paste this verification link into your browser:</p>
        <p><a href="${verificationUrl}" style="color: #2563eb; word-break: break-all;">${verificationUrl}</a></p>
        <hr style="border: none; border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; margin: 20px 0;" />
        <p style="font-size: 12px; color: #777;">If you did not sign up for a DockSlot account, you can safely ignore this email.</p>
      </div>
    `;

    const text = `Welcome to DockSlot!\n\nPlease verify your email by opening the following link:\n${verificationUrl}\n\nIf you did not sign up for DockSlot, please ignore this email.`;

    return this.sendMail({ to: email, subject, html, text });
  }

  /**
   * Send a [REDACTED:generic-password] reset link email.
   */
  public async sendPasswordResetEmail(email: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const resetUrl = `${mailConfig.frontendUrl}/reset-[REDACTED:generic-password]?token=${token}`;

    const subject = 'Reset your DockSlot [REDACTED:generic-password]';
    const html = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; color: #333; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px;">
        <h2 style="color: #2563eb;">Password Reset Request</h2>
        <p>We received a request to reset your DockSlot account [REDACTED:generic-password]. Click the button below to choose a new [REDACTED:generic-password]:</p>
        <div style="margin: 30px 0;">
          <a href="${resetUrl}" style="background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; display: inline-block;">Reset Password</a>
        </div>
```
